settings_adv.title: Advanced
settings_adv.default_png: PNG is usually a great choice
settings_adv.frame_or_window: Take the size from the original video or how it looks on screen
settings_adv.default_0_9: How much to squeeze the file (from 0 to 9, best to leave at 4)
settings_adv.default_0_100: The higher the number, the better the quality (0 to 100)
settings_adv.default_off: Best not to touch if unsure (default is off)
settings_adv.hotkey_sub_ex: Which button to press to save the picture with subtitles included
settings_adv.hotkey_no_sub_ex: Which button to press to get a clean picture with no text
settings_adv.default_u: Ignore the subtitles design built into the video and always use yours
settings_adv.default_font: Which font to use for the text
settings_adv.default_size: How large the text will be (default is 80)
settings_adv.default_border: How thick the line around the letters is (default 4)
settings_adv.default_shadow: How far the shadow is pushed from the letters (default 1.5)
settings_adv.default_margin: How high above the bottom edge the subtitles sit (default 60)
settings_adv.scale_window_ex: Subtitles will resize based on the player window, rather than the video itself
settings_adv.default_lanczos: A more complex algorithm gives better quality, but uses more resources
settings_adv.default_auto: Removes blocky 'steps' on smooth color transitions
settings_adv.default_yes: Makes picture clearer when window is smaller than video
settings_adv.deband_desc: Smooths out harsh color transitions (like blocky dark skies)
settings_adv.default_3: How many times to apply the filter (more is better quality)
settings_adv.default_30: How strongly to blend neighboring colors
settings_adv.hwdec_desc: Use the graphics card to play video (saves battery and keeps computer cool)
settings_adv.sonoko_enable_ex: Send the current video time straight to the subtitle editor with a button press
settings_adv.video_sync_desc: Makes the picture smoother. Will take effect after restarting the player.
settings_adv.interpolation_desc: Removes stuttering during fast movement. Will take effect after restarting the player.

settings_interface.title: Interface
settings_interface.hide_controls_sub: Hide the buttons from the screen if you don't touch the mouse
settings_interface.hide_timeout_sub: How many seconds before the buttons disappear
settings_interface.chapter_markers_sub: Show on the progress bar where new episodes or important parts start
settings_interface.lmb_sub: What happens if you click the left mouse button on the video
settings_interface.rmb_sub: What happens if you click the right mouse button on the video
settings_interface.mmb_sub: What happens if you click the middle mouse button on the video
settings_interface.wheel_up_sub: What happens if you scroll the mouse wheel away from you
settings_interface.wheel_down_sub: What happens if you scroll the mouse wheel toward you
settings_interface.volume_step_sub: How much the volume will change at once
settings_interface.seek_step_sub: How many seconds the video will jump forward or backward
settings_interface.default_f: Expand the video to fill the whole screen
settings_interface.default_esc: Return the video to a normal window
settings_interface.default_m: Turn the sound completely off or on
settings_interface.default_u: Change how the text looks on the screen

settings_audio.remember_volume_sub: Remember how loud it was last time, so it doesn't blast your ears
settings_audio.normalize_audio_sub: Makes quiet sounds easier to hear, and loud sounds won't hurt your ears
settings_audio.default_volume_sub: How loud it will be when you open a video for the very first time

settings_playback.autoplay_sub: The video will start playing by itself as soon as you open it
settings_playback.single_window_sub: New videos will open right here, instead of opening a bunch of new windows
settings_playback.default_speed_sub: The speed at which all new videos will start playing

settings_track.pref_audio_sub: Which language do you want to hear (e.g. en, ru)
settings_track.pref_sub_sub: Which language do you want to read text in (e.g. en, ru)
settings_track.smart_autoload_desc: Automatically finds and turns on the right translation if it's in the same folder

state.error_open: Could not open or play the file.
